# Vendored CGBN

Source: https://github.com/NVlabs/CGBN

Downloaded archive: https://codeload.github.com/NVlabs/CGBN/tar.gz/master

Archive SHA-256: `8e3d2e23ec1da39df1400c0c9daa13b60ddce307f0ed853b1392c53b783250b8`

Fetched 2026-09-15. The archive was downloaded from the upstream master branch;
the SHA-256 identifies the exact downloaded snapshot. Only `include/` and the
upstream `LICENSE` are bundled. Those upstream files are unmodified.

The project uses its own CUDA kernels and has not copied the sample benchmark
programs. CGBN's MIT license is retained in `LICENSE` and in upstream source headers.
